description: Read public Threads profiles the way a logged out visitor sees them. Returns one row per profile with username, name, verified mark, follower count, bio, bio links, and profile photo, plus one row per post the profile page shows (the newest threads and the author's continuation posts) with text, date, likes, replies, reposts, quotes, and media links.

include_posts.description: yes (default): one row per post the profile page shows to a logged out visitor, the newest threads with the author's own continuation posts. no: profile rows only.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Free rows are always returned.

profiles.description: Threads usernames (zuck or @zuck) or profile links (https://www.threads.com/@zuck, threads.net links work too). A post link is read as its author's profile. In Clay, wrap a column in a one item list.

name: get_threads_profiles
title: Get Threads profiles and posts
